mapper.sql: CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(${col}, '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(${col})) END
mapper.select:
SELECT A.EMPID, A.LOCAL_NAME, A.SEX_NAME, A.DEPT_NAME, A.POST_GRADE_NAME, A.DATE_STARTED, A.COURSE_NAME_CODE, A.PERIOD_TIME, A.TRAIN_CONTENT, A.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, A.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(A.START_D, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.END_D, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, A.TRAIN_ADDRESS, A.DEPART_MANA_CODE_NAME, A.ALL_COST, A.EVA_RESULT, A.BASIC_NO, A.RESULT_NO, A.HISTORY_FLAG FROM (
SELECT E.EMPID, NVL(H.LOCAL_NAME, E.LOCAL_NAME) AS LOCAL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PI.SEXCODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SEX_NAME, H.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, B.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(B.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(B.TRAIN_CONTENT) AS TRAIN_CONTENT, B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, B.IMPLE_START_DATE AS START_D, B.IMPLE_END_DATE AS END_D, B.TRAIN_ADDRESS, NVL(GET_DEPT_NAME(P.DEPART_MANA_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), P.DEPART_MANA_CODE) AS DEPART_MANA_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(NVL(M.TEACHER_COST, 0) + NVL(M.MATERIAL_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FIELD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FOOD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.STAY_COST, 0) + NVL(M.TRAFFIC_COST, 0) + NVL(M.VISA_COST, 0) + NVL(M.OTHER_COST, 0)) AS ALL_COST, TO_CHAR(ROUND( * 0.6 + (SELECT AVG() FROM EDU_STUDENT_CHECK S WHERE S.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND S.STU_EMPID = E.EMPID AND S.ACTIVITY = 1) * 0.4)) AS EVA_RESULT, TO_CHAR(B.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(R.RESULT_NO)) FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND R.STU_EMPID = E.EMPID AND R.ACTIVITY = 1) AS RESULT_NO, 0 AS HISTORY_FLAG FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE E JOIN EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B ON B.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND B.ACTIVITY = '1' LEFT JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = B.PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_COST_MANAGER M ON M.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO AND M.ACTIVITY = 1 LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = E.EMPID LEFT JOIN HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI ON PI.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND B.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
UNION ALL
SELECT T.EMPID, NVL(H.LOCAL_NAME, T.LOCAL_NAME) AS LOCAL_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PI.SEXCODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SEX_NAME, H.DEPTNO, NVL(GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), T.DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME, NVL(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), T.POST_GRADE_NAME) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, T.EDU_CLASS AS COURSE_NAME_CODE, T.EDU_TIMES AS PERIOD_TIME, NULL AS TRAIN_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(T.EDU_TIME_LENGTH) AS IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, '2' AS IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, T.START_D, T.END_D, T.EDU_LOCATION AS TRAIN_ADDRESS, NULL AS DEPART_MANA_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(NVL(T.EDU_COST, 0)) AS ALL_COST, TO_CHAR(T.PASS_SCORE) AS EVA_RESULT, NULL AS BASIC_NO, NULL AS RESULT_NO, 1 AS HISTORY_FLAG FROM (SELECT X.PERSON_ID AS EMPID, X.LOCAL_NAME, X.DEPT_NAME, X.POST_GRADE_NAME, X.EDU_CLASS, X.EDU_TIMES, X.EDU_TIME_LENGTH, X.EDU_LOCATION, X.EDU_COST, X.PASS_SCORE, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.EDU_BEGIN_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$') THEN TO_DATE(X.EDU_BEGIN_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS START_D, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.EDU_END_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$') THEN TO_DATE(X.EDU_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS END_D FROM EDU_TRAIN_BASIC_HISTORY X WHERE X.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) T LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = T.EMPID LEFT JOIN HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI ON PI.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID
) A WHERE A.START_D >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND A.END_D <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND (A.EMPID = #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(A.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
AND A.DEPTNO IN (SELECT D.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
AND UPPER(A.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND UPPER(A.TRAIN_CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
ORDER BY A.HISTORY_FLAG, A.COURSE_NAME_CODE, A.PERIOD_TIME, A.EMPID
